fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg configuration-driven provider registration
fields.condition: a host builds an Orleans silo from configuration that names a provider type in Orleans:{Kind}:{name}:ProviderType
fields.trigger: the provider type is ArgentSeaPg or ArgentSeaPgDb
fields.response: ArgentSeaPg resolves grain storage to the shard-set builder (ShardSetKey), and clustering and reminders to this package's membership and reminder tables; ArgentSeaPgDb resolves grain storage to the single-database builder (DatabaseKey). Each builder takes its key from the provider's own section, else the OrleansData section, else Default, and throws when neither section exists
fields.postcondition: each storage kind is reachable from configuration; no two RegisterProvider attributes in the package share a (type, kind, side) key and none uses a SQL Server type name
